title: Foreign keys and constraints
objective: PRIMARY KEY, FOREIGN KEY and CHECK are data invariants, not optional form hints. Constraints reject invalid writes even when the application has a bug.
misconception: The starter's task-notes table accepts an orphan task reference and a whitespace-only note.
acceptance: An FK prevents orphan IDs but does not guarantee the same tenant; cross-tenant composite keys and authorization policies are covered later. CHECK constraints accept UNKNOWN, so pair constraints with NOT NULL deliberately.
securityBoundary: Neither UI validation nor TypeScript types prevent direct SQL clients from inserting invalid rows.
